headline: Deferred subdivision at 146 East Avenue and appeal at 281 Pearl Street to October 6, 2026; no decision made on fence variance at 228 North Winooski Avenue.
summary: The board voted to defer two items, a subdivision case at 146 East Avenue and a notice-of-violation appeal at 281 Pearl Street, to the October 6, 2026 meeting. The board also heard a variance request from Champlain Housing Trust to install a six-foot fence at 228 North Winooski Avenue to address homeless encampments and security issues, but closed the hearing to deliberate without recording a final decision.
decisions: Deferred the ZP-26-387 subdivision case at 146 East Avenue to the October 6, 2026 DRB meeting, by a vote of 5-0.
Deferred the ZAP-26-12 appeal of a Notice of Violation at 281 Pearl Street to the October 6, 2026 DRB meeting, by a vote of 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Miles Waite: Motioned to defer to the 10/6/26 DRB meeting, Chase Taylor 2nd. Vote 5-0. Motion carried.
